_source: Hand-written 2026-11-03 from the smart-photos API contract (scratch smart/COMMON.md: live-hint `blocking`, every OMR page `result {tier, review_count, message, tips, preview_url, applied}`, sheets `modes` + mode / order / index), each built ON a recorded reply of omr_scan_payloads.json (same ids and texts) by scratch smart/fe/make_fixtures.py. The backend was built in parallel: re-record from its real routes once it lands (the field names in the contract are binding; `prefilled_reason` and the map form of `modes` are the front's tolerant guesses).

_source_round3: 2026-11-03 (UI fix round): batch_v3 / review_items_v3 / review_item_v3_* follow the round-3 contract the backend is changing in parallel (review_count = questions only, student identified | unidentified | confirm, one-sentence message with ' — ', identifier reading student_name / masked_id / other_page_no / other_file_name, value null when nothing was read, items with page_no / file_name / batch_id / batch_created_at); batch_old_identity / review_items_old / review_item_old_* are the shapes the stack answered before it (identity counted in review_count, ' - … (…)' messages, value '??', no page fields). Re-record from the real routes once the backend lands.
